text: The benchmark suite's long-repeats row (ten copies of a 1 MiB unit, 10 MiB, 4 threads) varies by up to 45% in instruction count between runs of the same binary: perf stat on sufr at c9c880d gave 542G, 657G and 789G instructions over three runs. Wall time swings with it. A before/after delta on that row means nothing without many repeats; the normal, long-n and protein rows are stable to 1-2%. Measured 2026-11-03.
